items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I played with George E. Lee as Julia's brother. ... Yeah, I was in the band for George E. Lee's band.

ctx.x: Did you ever know a drummer there who came from this part of the country, Baby Lovett? Well yeah. Used to play with Julia Lee, I guess you met him.
Well yeah, well I told him about the Lee, I played with Julia's brother. Julia played piano in the band when I was with her brother.
Oh really? Yeah, I know they had a band. Yeah. They made a record. That's right.
